articles.title: 3 resume tips from Google recruiter that can help you stand out from the crow and get hired
articles.description: A recruiter from Google’s Dublin office has shared three practical resume tips that can help job seekers improve their applications. In a video posted by Life at Google, recruiter Amanda advised candidates to mirror the job description, clearly highlight the minimum qualifications, and keep their resumes short and easy to read. She also stressed the importance of using measurable results, such as percentages and team sizes, to show the impact of previous work experience.
